# WriteSmartTech

WriteSmartTech (WriteSmart Technologies) is The Desk: academic writing, tutoring, and editing by email from Cephas Nyamai Mutisya.

Primary site: https://writesmarttech.com/desk/
Contact: cephasmutisya02@gmail.com

The Desk takes academic work in every field and assignment type. Fees start from USD 10 and are quoted after the student sends a brief. Urgent tasks can be completed within hours when the deadline allows. Every delivery includes a free AI report and a free plagiarism report.

A separate product line for freelance writers lives at https://writesmarttech.com/bots/ (Chrome bidding extensions for Writedom and WritersHub). That is not the main business of the domain.
